name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, December 19, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Certificate of Recognition - Richard Colbary, former Los Angeles County Library Commissioner and City Commissioner
b.
Proclamation - Teresa Vallejo Retirement
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-k be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of December 5, 2017 and the Regular Meeting of December 5, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
September and October Treasurer Report
ACTION: That the September and October report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Receive and file contract for Professional Services Agreement with Quantum Quality Consulting Inc., for engineering services
ACTION: That the contract for engineering services with Quantum Quality Consulting, Inc., be received and filed.
Item #7j
k.
Award a contract for Professional Services with Administrative Services Co-Op (ASC) dba South Bay Yellow Cab and United Checker Cab for the Dial-a-Ride Program
ACTION: That the City Manager be authorized to execute a three-year contract with Administrative Services Co-Op (ASC) dba South Bay Yellow Cab and United Checker Cab Co-Op, to provide Dial-a-Ride (DAR) Program services for a three-year term, with two additional one year renewal options for a possible maximum of five years.
Item #7k
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
DISCUSSION AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE CITY'S AUDIT REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2016-2017
Presented by Ron Lopez and Matt Lenton, Gruber and Associates, City Auditor
ACTION: That the City Council receive and file the Fiscal Year 2016-2017 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR).
Item #8
9.
CONSIDERATION AND ADOPTION OF THE CITY OF LOMITA EMERGENCY OPERATION PLAN
Presented by Management Analyst Vander Neut
RES 2017-39 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California adopting an amended Emergency Operations Plan.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the resolution adopting the City of Lomita Emergency Operations Plan.
Item #9
10.
DISCUSSION RE: COMMISSION ATTENDANCE AND RECRUITMENT AND CONSIDERATION EXCUSING AN ABSENCE FOR JACOB HOY, PLANNING COMMISSIONER, AND FOR BRYAN MATTHEWS, PARKS COMMISSIONER
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council: 1) Determine by minute order, one absence for Planning Commissioner Jacob Hoy be excused; and, 2) Determine by minute order, one absence for Parks Commissioner Bryan Matthews be excused; and, 3) Provide staff direction re: attendance and absence policies for Commissions/Boards.
Item #10
11.
APPOINTMENT OF COUNCIL MEMBERS ASSIGNMENTS TO VARIOUS ORGANIZATIONS
Item #11
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
12.
PUBLIC HEARING - DISCUSSION ON CODE AMENDMENT NO. 2017-07 REMOVAL OF GRAFFITI
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Mayor to open the hearing.
ORD NO. 795 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, amending Chapter 6 (Removal of Graffiti) of the Lomita Municipal Code relating to Graffiti Abatement Procedures and Cost-Recovery and increasing the fine amounts for violation of the Chapter. (First Reading)
1.
Introduce on first reading an ordinance amending Chapter 6 of Title V of the Municipal Code relating to graffiti and graffiti abatement; and
2.
Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the January 16, 2018 Council meeting.
Item #12
13.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONFIRMATION OF THE COST FOR NUISANCE ABATEMENT FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 2403 ESTHER VIEW DRIVE AND THE PLACEMENT OF A LIEN TO RECOUP THOSE COSTS
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Mayor to open the hearing.
RES 2017-40 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, confirming the cost and ordering the recordation of an abatement lien against the property located at 2403 Esther View Drive (APN 7553-019-042) in the amount of $1,450.
1.
Adopt the resolution confirming the cost to abate a public nuisance for the property located at 2403 Esther View Drive in the amount of $1,450; and
2.
Direct staff to file a lien on the property for the cost of the abatement.
Item #13
14.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, January 16, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA. Please note that the Regular City Council meeting for January 2, 2018 has been cancelled.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
